title: Family Fun
text:
We went as a family (two teenagers) and we're the only ones there and it was great. Not much peddling, none really, but we had a good swim in the sea. It'd been a long time since I'd dived off a boat and the kids' first.

It's probably more geared up for groups of young adults, and I can totally see how that would be a great laugh, but it worked for us as well.
author: F569WQpaulb

title: Great
text: My husband and I enjoyed this particular activity because we saw different jelly fishes, where the beach was located and other options that we could do on the water.
author: Nadine_C
